meta.title: The equation behind every bridge | Pythagorean theorem in 40 seconds
meta.description: Why a squared plus b squared equals c squared shows up in construction, maps and games.
facts_to_verify: The theorem has been known for over 2,500 years (Babylonian tablets are older; the Greek proof is attributed to Pythagoras).

scenes.narration: This one equation built every bridge you have ever crossed.

scenes.title: Pythagorean theorem
scenes.narration: In a right triangle, the squares of the two short sides add up to the square of the longest side. Take the square root, and you can find any missing length.

scenes.title: Used in
scenes.narration: Builders use it to keep walls square. Your phone uses it to compute distance. Games use it to move characters.
People have known this for over two and a half thousand years.
